subject: Retainer collection checklist, tranche lanes, and ledger clearing
messages:
From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@atlasfinance.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap@atlasfinance.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual retainer invoice schedule + VAT evidence

Hi Neha,

Thanks again — Atlas is ready to lock the retainer schedule for FY27. We need: 1) an invoice cadence we can feed into our AP system (monthly/quarterly/tranche) 2) a short list of VAT evidence we must keep for our auditors, and 3) the bank details + remit names you want on invoices.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will issue a single annual invoice with monthly drawdowns, or separate tranche invoices tied to milestone windows? We have internal controls that prefer discrete invoice numbers per drawdown.

Attached is our PO reference (PO-AT-4491) and a CSV of our internal GL mapping. We aim to process the first payment by Jun 18.

Appreciate a short checklist we can circulate to AP.

Best,
Sara Holt
Head of Finance Operations
Atlas Finance

--
Attachment stubs: PO-AT-4491.pdf (application/pdf), atlas_gl_map.csv (text/csv)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@atlasfinance.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual retainer invoice schedule + VAT evidence

Sara — thanks for the clear ask. High level proposal below, and I attached an editable schedule (2027Q2_Redwood_Retainer_InvoiceSchedule.xlsx) plus our VAT certificate bundle. TL;DR: we will issue quarterly invoices with monthly drawdown memos, unless you require discrete invoice numbers per payment — we can do that but it adds extra ledger entries.

Proposal (recommended):
- Master invoice per quarter (Q3/Q4/Q1/Q2) for the committed amount, with monthly settlement drawdown memos referencing the master invoice number.
- If Atlas requires separate invoice numbers per payment for AP reconciliation, we will issue per-tranche invoices (one invoice per scheduled payment).

Checklist for your AP team (short):
- Required invoice fields: Invoice #, Master/Tranche ref, Invoice date, Due date, Amount (USD), VAT line (if applicable), Redwood remit name: Redwood Inference Inc., Redwood remit account: Redwood US Operating, SWIFT: REDWUS33, IBAN: (USD wiring as attached).
- VAT evidence: Redwood VAT certificate (attached), signed SOW (if country-specific VAT treatment needed), and a copy of the invoice with payment trace.
- PO mapping: include PO-AT-4491 in the invoice header.

Attachments: 2027Q2_Redwood_Retainer_InvoiceSchedule.xlsx, Redwood_VAT_Certificates.pdf

Next steps: 1) confirm whether Atlas prefers master+memo or discrete invoices, 2) confirm bank remit name to appear on invoice, 3) confirm first drawdown date (we propose Jun 20).

Thanks — copying Ben for ledger & collection ops.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Calendly: https://cal.redwood.com/neha

--
Attachment stubs: 2027Q2_Redwood_Retainer_InvoiceSchedule.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), Redwood_VAT_Certificates.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@atlasfinance.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual retainer invoice schedule + VAT evidence

Sara — quick operational notes from ledger / collection side:

1) If Atlas prefers master invoice + monthly memos: our internal ledger will book the master invoice to revenue deferral and post monthly drawdowns as debit memos. That flows to your AP as references: MasterInv-<ID> / Memo-<month>.
2) If separate invoices per payment (preferred by your auditors), we will create per-payment invoices. Please confirm a) tax jurisdiction for VAT treatment (we have the certificate bundle but need country-specific applicability), and b) whether Atlas will remit via ACH or wire. Wire is preferred for international accounts.

Action items for Atlas AP (proposed):
- Confirm preferred invoice numbering approach (master+memo or per-payment).
- Confirm remit name exactly as appears on your bank. Example: "Atlas Finance Ltd (AP)" vs "Atlas Finance — Treasury".
- Provide any additional currency mapping (we can invoice USD, GBP, EUR).

I also attached a short ledger-clearing checklist for our internal workflow — that's inside the Excel you received. If you want a doc we can map to your GL csv and return a sample invoice pre-filled.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: ledger_clearing_notes.txt (text/plain)

From: Tom Gibbons <tom.gibbons@atlasfinance.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sara Holt <sara.holt@atlasfinance.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@atlasfinance.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual retainer invoice schedule + VAT evidence

Ben / Team — quick answers from AP:
- Atlas prefers discrete invoice numbers per payment for audit traceability.
- Remit name: "Atlas Finance Treasury" (please ensure identical).
- Payment method: wire for first payment; ACH for recurring monthly payments domestically.
- Tax jurisdiction: payments originate from the US entity; VAT only applies where Redwood has local VAT registration. We'll accept VAT lines where present and claim input tax where applicable.

We can share the PO and expect the first wire to clear by Jun 25 if invoice issued by Jun 18. Please issue the first tranche invoice with Invoice# format: AF-2027-RDW-001.

Thanks,
Tom Gibbons
AP Manager
Atlas Finance

Tom — thanks for confirming. We'll proceed with discrete invoices per payment using the Invoice# pattern AF-2027-RDW-###. Operational items we will complete by Jun 16:

1) Generate and email first tranche invoice (AF-2027-RDW-001) for the Jun 25 wire. Invoice will include: PO-AT-4491, Atlas remit name exactly as provided, and VAT lines where applicable.
2) Provide a short cover email (to ap@atlasfinance.com) that lists the GL mapping and references the HubSpot deal ID.
3) Send a copy of the signed Mutual Action Plan once countersigned (attached below).

If you want, we can also ship a one-page mapping that shows how MasterInv/Memo vs Tranche invoices reconcile in your GL — happy to pair with your AP on a 30-minute walkthrough.

Lauren Bishop
Revenue Accounting Lead
Redwood Inference
